title: ToolOverlay
description: Governance overlay for one MCP server in config/tools/ (blueprint section 14.2). Tools the server offers but this file does not list are unavailable. Connection details are deployment configuration and do not belong here.

name.description: The tool name as the MCP server exposes it.

external_side_effects.description: True if a call changes anything outside the sandbox and artifact store.

idempotent.description: True if calling again with the same idempotency key has no second effect and returns the first result. Recovery re-runs an interrupted call only for such a tool (ADR-0026). True needs idempotency_test.

idempotency_test.description: The test under the server that repeats a call with the same idempotency key and shows one effect, as <file>::<test>, the file relative to mcp_servers/<server_id>/. validate-config checks that it exists.
